title: The Unwritten Clock
author: Hazel Iversen
blurb: Ivo Dunmore, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
